  "phoneNote": "The three side-by-side arched hero photos become tiny, cramped thumbnails on a narrow phone screen, and the trade word 'frizerstvo' is missing from the mobile header.",
  "desktopNote": "The warm burgundy-and-blush palette, arched photo frames, and oversized background typography create a confident, salon-appropriate presentation with clear hierarchy.",

  },
  "fixes": [
    "On mobile, display the hero photos in a 2-column staggered layout or feature the central hair photo much larger instead of squeezing three narrow arches into one row.",
    "Keep the subtitle 'frizerstvo' next to the LANA wordmark in the mobile header so the business trade is immediately clear without reading the body text.",
    "Remove the redundant 'Pokličite' button below the giant phone number in the Naročanje section, and make the phone number itself a tappable link."
  ]
}
